title: Functional Items - MoU
description: The mod serves as a foundation for future additions and will continue to grow alongside the modpack.
body:
is a content mod created specifically for a larger custom modpack. Its goal is to provide unique functional items that support gameplay, immersion, progression, and custom mechanics used throughout the pack.

The mod is designed as a foundation for future expansion. New items, tools, utilities, and gameplay features will be added over time as the modpack evolves.

## Current Features

### Poseidon's Trident

A powerful custom trident with unique mechanics and abilities.

Features include:

* Two switchable operating modes.
  1. Throw mode for ranged attacks. 
  2. Dash mode for rapid movement and attack.
* Automatic return after being thrown.
* Custom lightning strike ability during rain and thunderstorms.
* Custom textures and visual mode indicators.
* Independent balancing and enchantment restrictions.

### Writable Items

The mod currently includes three writable items:

* Document
* Note
* Journal

These items allow players to create and store their own written content, making them useful for roleplay, quest tracking, documentation, exploration notes, base management, and personal records.

Each item serves as an alternative way to organize information within the game world.

## Designed for a Modpack

This mod is not intended to be a standalone content expansion. Instead, it acts as a dedicated utility module for a larger modpack, providing custom mechanics and items tailored to that experience.

Future updates may introduce:

* New functional tools
* Utility items
* Progression-related mechanics
* Exploration features
* Additional quality-of-life systems
* Integration with other mods used in the modpack

## Localization

The mod currently includes translations for the following languages:

* German (de_de)
* English (en_us)
* Spanish (es_es)
* French (fr_fr)
* Japanese (ja_jp)
* Korean (ko_kr)
* Brazilian Portuguese (pt_br)
* Russian (ru_ru)
* Ukrainian (uk_ua)
* Simplified Chinese (zh_cn)

More languages may be added in future updates.
